mission: Consume the already-durable B42 Primary Chat canary RETURN and project exactly its sanitized PONG reply into the existing CHAT_THREAD_MIRROR_CANARY_V1 owner using the existing reconciliation semantics. Then promote that same canonical RETURN from BOUNDARY to DONE only after the durable thread reload proves reply_to_message_id, response text and result_ref. Do not change product code, create a new chat authority, scheduler, queue, CURRENT or expose private payloads.

Reuse the existing CHAT_THREAD_MIRROR_CANARY_V1 projection; do not create another thread owner.
Persist exactly one PUBLIC_SANITIZED_CANARY WORKER reply for MSG-HUMAN-CANARY-B42DC9B7-6E50-4DFD-97FF-ACB438A1E3E5 with response PONG and a durable result_ref to the canonical RETURN.
Reload the durable thread and verify message id, actor, response text, publication metadata and result_ref.
Only after projection verification, update the canonical B42 RETURN outcome/completion fields from BOUNDARY to DONE/SUCCESS and clear the projection residual without rewriting unrelated evidence.
Persist a compact reconciliation receipt and normal worker RETURN with exact changed paths and checks.
No product bytes, scheduler, queue, Current, Served, Human Accepted or private payload authority changes.
